integrity: The proof is exact and self-contained: it classifies all subset-sum collision patterns for three positive integer weights, derives the entropy formula for each pattern, and proves strict negative curvature analytically. Finite computations were used only as exploratory stress tests and are not evidence for the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The proof resolves only the third recursive level. It does not cover levels four and above, other Rényi orders, independently varying Bernoulli parameters, or infinite Bernoulli convolutions. An equivalent older three-weight result under different subset-sum terminology remains a literature-search risk.
title: Three-step overlap Bernoulli entropy is always strictly concave
